architecture: peptide Linear(384,64) + learned position embedding (9); receptor Linear(384,64); 2 x [cross-attention 4 heads, 16-Gaussian distance bias on the logits, residual+LayerNorm; FFN 64->128->64, residual+LayerNorm]; attention pooling over the 9 peptide tokens; head Linear(64,128) -> GELU -> Dropout(0.3) -> Linear(128,32) -> GELU -> Dropout(0.3) -> Linear(32,1)

dataset.split_note: peptides held out: a test 9-mer appears nowhere in train, under any allele
dataset.target: thalf_hours, log10, zeros floored at half the smallest positive value
